name: Stop Script in Upload Mode Prevents End of Runtime
hint: In an uploaded Codey program, stopping all scripts while a timed hardware action is still running can leave that action incomplete and the device in an unexpected resource state. The same risk exists when upload-mode execution is only a possible path.
instruction: Give each timed hardware action an explicit stop or reset before stopping all scripts, and make every upload-mode entry path follow that cleanup sequence.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when on-board button [B v] :: events hat
@codeyA turn right at power (50) % for (60) secs :: motion

when on-board button [C v] :: events hat
stop [all v]
